name: Wizard Agent Service
short_desc: Wizard API, durable runs and single app gateway.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Headless Wizard API; independently installed shell. Host Hermes in alongside mode.

form_fields.label: Hermes API key
form_fields.hint: The HERMES_API_KEY of your hermes-agent app (Runtipi > Hermes Agent > Settings).

form_fields.label: Orb router URL (optional)
form_fields.hint: OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL for a fast, cheap model. Leave empty to send every orb request to the agent.
